title: webhook-platform values
description: The one hard requirement is externalDatabase.url. This chart ships no database and must not be installable without one.

externalDatabase.description: External PostgreSQL. Required. The platform never bundles a database (ARCHITECTURE.md 36).

url.description: REQUIRED. PostgreSQL connection URL, e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:6432/webhook_platform?schema=public&sslmode=require. Point at PgBouncer in production.

directUrl.description: Direct (non-pooled) connection used by migrations. Defaults to url when empty.

url.description: Optional. Cache and coordination only; never durable state.

allowPrivateNetworks.description: Disables the SSRF guard's private-range refusal. Prefer privateAllowlist.

replicaCount.description: Singleton by design. More than one scheduler duplicates polling for no gain.

maxReplicas.description: Database ceiling, not a CPU one: (maxReplicas + ingest + router + scheduler) x externalDatabase.maxConnections must fit under max_connections / PgBouncer default_pool_size. A worker pod that cannot get its pool exits 1.

enabled.description: Renders the migration Job. Keep false in the normal release; run migrations as their own explicit step (ARCHITECTURE.md 41).

networkPolicy.description: Default-deny NetworkPolicies. ENFORCED ONLY IF YOUR CNI IMPLEMENTS NetworkPolicy - stock EKS (amazon-vpc-cni with no policy agent), flannel and a default kind/minikube accept these objects and silently ignore them.

dnsNamespace.description: Namespace running CoreDNS/kube-dns. Egress to :53 is allowed here and nowhere else, so an empty value leaves the platform unable to resolve any hostname.

datastoreCidrs.description: Where PostgreSQL/PgBouncer/Redis live. A database on a PUBLIC address (Neon, Upstash, a public RDS endpoint) is not in private space - add the provider's range or the control plane cannot connect.

blockedEgressCidrs.description: Subtracted from the worker's 0.0.0.0/0 egress; the layer-3 mirror of internal/egress/ssrf.go's blocklist. Shortening this widens the SSRF surface - 169.254.0.0/16 in particular is the cloud instance metadata endpoint.

extraEgress.description: Raw NetworkPolicyEgressRule entries applied to every pod in the release.
